# JSG Construction Limited

> Residential building contractor based in Dublin, Ireland, directed by Sérgio Gratival (Managing Director & Master Builder). Specialises in high-value home extensions, full house renovations, and architectural builds across Dublin, Kildare, and Wicklow, backed by €6.5M public liability insurance and an eight-person in-house crew.

## Services

- House extensions (single and two-storey)
- Full house renovations and back-to-brick modernisations
- Structural steel knock-throughs
- Architectural builds compliant with BCAR (Building Control Regulations) and RIAI contracts

## Area served

Dublin South, Dublin North, Dun Laoghaire-Rathdown, Ranelagh, Blackrock, Dalkey, Malahide, Howth, County Wicklow, County Kildare, County Meath.

## Pages

- [Homepage](https://www.jsgconstruction.ie/): services, pricing range, and on-site assessment booking.
- [Building Intelligence guides](https://www.jsgconstruction.ie/articles.html): 20 technical and statutory guides covering planning exemptions, BCAR compliance, structural costs, and SEAI grants for Dublin homeowners.
